title: Demotic Chronicle (P. Paris BN 215 recto) / «Демотическая хроника»
author: Anonymous Egyptian priest(s)
edition: Spiegelberg, Die sogenannte demotische Chronik (1914; public domain, archive.org); Felber 2002 (German); Quack 2015 (study).
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found: ru.wikipedia mentions it only in a navbox; CyberLeninka hits are studies (Ладынин) citing it.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia points to an annotated English course translation (yorku.ca/pswarney/2110/dem-chron); no standard published English found.
value: Egyptian verdict on Persian rule, Teos, Nectanebo I–II and the Greeks. An oracle with commentary, i.e. Egyptian 'scholia'. Vital for Ptolemaic ideology and the Nectanebo legend of the Alexander Romance.
ai_feasibility: low-medium: LLMs are weak in Demotic. Work from Spiegelberg's public-domain transcription; cryptic oracle phrasing needs an Egyptologist reviewer.
